rules: Official catalog-resource parentage is identity evidence, not by itself byte-level payload equivalence.
The primary explicit official data.gov.in CSV is byte-bound to the governed candidate by exact SHA-256 and byte count.
HTTP 403 on the alternate explicit official alias is missing equivalence evidence and does not establish equality, inequality, retirement, or canonicality.
Partial authoritative retrieval does not authorize deterministic canonical alias selection.
The resource-level updated-on date and monthly granularity do not establish the observation date of individual facility records.
Names or normalized spellings alone never establish administrative equivalence.
Missing remains null and is never silently converted to zero.
Observed systematic zeros are not evidence of true absence until authoritative field semantics establish that interpretation.
This receipt stores metadata and aggregate bindings only; it stores no source rows or privacy-risk values.
